subject: Google Research
object: Up until TimesFM-2.5 (released in September 2025), our models were strictly limited to univariate forecasting: forecasting using only the history of a single time series. Yet, most real-world forecasting problems are inherently multivariate: where multiple time series and auxiliary external features jointly impact the future forecast of a time series. Consider forecasting ice cream sales for a retail chain. Past sales alone rarely tell the full story. A good forecast should also draw on sales of related products (e.g., ice cream cones, syrups), historical foot traffic, and known future events like weather forecasts, promotions, and holidays.
